helper_findings.title: Require exact cases, event order and correlated receipts before issuing six-case PASS
helper_findings.mechanism: v1 builds an unordered dictionary of trace events and checks presence/values, never sequence. A control moved before boot or after-state moved before receipt still satisfies its checks. It does not require exactly the six expected driver cases: removing the own-identity case leaves all five hard-coded comparison cases available and can still produce PASS while post-inputs merely has length6. Receipt host_id and before/after health are never matched to the chosen object, and summary alive/health fields are not matched to before/after rows.
helper_findings.consequence: This one-shot helper can accept structurally incomplete or incoherent proof; its PASS alone is insufficient for future publication/reuse. Independent strict inspection here found all six actual retained traces correctly ordered and correlated, so no native-run defect or native rerun requirement was found.
helper_findings.bounded_correction: Preserve v1 script/proof. Add exact six-case/config-set validation and per-mode exact event sequence, boot/run configuration checks, chosen-object receipt and summary state correlation; require successful original drivers/native exits as before. Include moved-control/after-before-receipt, missing-own, receipt-ID/value and summary mismatch controls on unchanged in-memory data. No physical source, baselines, tolerance or native changes needed.
helper_findings.control_status: Concrete acceptance mechanism established from source; reviewer did not execute v1 or modify input traces. Root acknowledged and is preparing v2 separately; that new code is not part of this review.
